description: A comment right after the closing marker makes the line content
notes: The spec's grammar ends a heredoc with Identifier Newline and treats a line comment as equivalent to a newline, so EOT# done could end the heredoc and leave the last EOT as a stray token. Its prose requires the marker to be on a line of its own, though, and comments can't begin inside template literals. hashicorp/hcl only ends the heredoc when the whole line, apart from surrounding whitespace, equals the marker (the heredocLiteralEOL action in hclsyntax/scan_tokens.rl), so that line is content and the next one ends the heredoc.
